purpose: resolve common user problems on first contact and pass on what cannot be resolved, with everything the next team needs
entry_criteria: Support channels and a ticket system exist
Runbooks and a knowledge base exist (stage 178)
procedure: Record the user's problem in their words, the affected account, and the time and steps that led to it.
Check the status page and known issues first, then search the knowledge base for a matching article.
Apply the documented fix, confirm with the user that it worked, and record what was done.
If there is no fix or the criteria are met, escalate with the full record, identifiers and impact; do not ask the user to repeat themselves.
Keep the user informed at the agreed intervals in plain language.
Tag the ticket by cause so recurring problems show up and become knowledge base articles.
acceptance_criteria: Ticket has identifiers, steps and time
Fixes follow runbooks and are confirmed with the user

validation.check: review five random closed tickets for identifiers, steps and confirmation
check the time to first response against the target

failure_modes.response: Link to the known issue and update the user

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A user cannot download an invoice. The agent finds a matching article, the fix works, the user confirms, and the ticket is tagged 'invoice download'; a second similar ticket the same week is escalated with the account id and error time.
